sections.label: DOM-Based and Client-Side Payloads
Source probes: place a unique marker and search the DOM/JS for it
location.hash sink payloads (innerHTML, jQuery selector, document.write)
location.search sink payloads (document.write and innerHTML)
Navigation sinks (location, location.href, window.open)
jQuery selector sink ($(location.hash)) older versions (< 1.9)
eval / Function / setTimeout string sinks
postMessage: sender-side probes (run from a page on a separate origin that opens or frames the target)
postMessage: listener-side patterns to look for in the source (missing or weak origin checks)
postMessage: origin-check bypass origins (host these on a domain you control)
DOM clobbering: overwrite a global used as a config or URL (inject HTML that is allowed through a sanitiser)
DOM clobbering: clobber a property that is later passed to a script loader
Client-side template injection: AngularJS 1.x (sandbox escape by version)
Client-side template injection: Vue.js
Prototype pollution sources on the client (query, hash and JSON)
Prototype pollution gadgets that reach a script or HTML sink (after a successful pollution)
window.name as a persistent cross-origin source
document.cookie / localStorage injection into sinks (set on a parent-domain or sibling subdomain you control)
Tabnabbing / reverse tabnabbing (link opened with target=_blank and no rel=noopener)
Open redirect to XSS (javascript: and data: schemes in navigation sinks)
Web messaging via BroadcastChannel / Service Worker / storage events (look for listeners that write to sinks)
Trusted Types and CSP checks (detection only)
DOM-based cookie manipulation / header-free sinks (document.domain, document.location.pathname)
